issue.title: test_muse_usage_probe_missed_mint_is_a_timeout_not_absence reports 'usage probe timed out' instead of muse_usage_mint_timeout under a loaded check lane

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-1jy.6 (note #2, epic sase-1jy). Check ToolRun 32e8e4c2b9d90ae40cb2cabe525de157 (2026-10-11, loaded host) failed at tests/llm_provider/test_muse_usage_probe.py:203 with "assert 'usage probe timed out' == 'muse_usage_mint_timeout'" (triaged NEW): the outer probe timeout fired before the mint timeout it is meant to classify. It passed in isolation on both the epic tree and a clean base, and the file passed in full on master d289b664a6 in the land agent's rerun. Fail rate: 1 loaded-lane failure, 0 serial failures.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (scoped lane under host load)

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1jy.6 note #2 during epic sase-1jy; a single load-time failure with no tracking bead, filed by the sase-1jy land agent so later reports can corroborate it.

payload.description: Confirm status and links after filing follow-up

evidence.note: Relayed independent evidence proposed by phase sase-1kh.3 note #1: check ToolRun d56f2c2ab1ea33c7551a9a0b7a8aeb83 failed the exact missed-mint timeout node, and the phase reports clean-base reproduction and run-to-run wobble. At master 1a638eac95 the lander serially reran the recorded phase3 nodes and this node passed. The original retained summary does not preserve its assertion, so no new timeout-cause claim is made. No epic commit changes the Muse probe.

payload.entry: Root cause: the missed-mint test ran the probe in an isolated worker under a 2.0s whole-probe deadline, so worker and fake-CLI interpreter start-up shared one wall clock with the mint wait; a loaded host spent it before the first request (reproduced by delaying worker start 1.4s). Fixed in phase sase-1mk.5: the test now runs in-process with a 1.0s mint wait and a 60s deadline, so start-up latency cannot reach the budget. No production change; production timeout behavior is untouched.

payload.description: Root-causing this flake for phase sase-1mk.5
